input: Read /data/test-results.txt which contains test output in a standard format. Parse it to: 1) Count total tests, passed, and failed. 2) Extract the names of all failing tests. 3) Generate a summary report at /reports/test-summary.md with a header '# Test Summary', a line 'Total: N | Passed: N | Failed: N', and a '## Failures' section listing each failed test. Print the summary.

transcript.final_response:
# Test Summary

Total: 12 | Passed: 9 | Failed: 3

## Failures
- test_login_expired_token
- test_signup_duplicate_email
- test_session_timeout

Saved to `/reports/test-summary.md`.
tool_calls:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
src = Path('/data/test-results.txt').read_text()
results = []
for line in src.splitlines():
    m = re.match(r'^\s*(PASS|FAIL)\s+(.+?)\s*$', line)
    if m:
        results.append((m.group(1), m.group(2)))
total = len(results)
passed = sum(status == 'PASS' for status, _ in results)
failures = [name for status, name in results if status == 'FAIL']
report = f"# Test Summary\n\nTotal: {total} | Passed: {passed} | Failed: {len(failures)}\n\n## Failures\n"
if failures:
    report += ''.join(f'- {name}\n' for name in failures)
else:
    report += '\n'
out = Path('/reports/test-summary.md')
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(report)
print(report, end='')
PY
